_readme: Approved announcements shown on events/. Append one object per item AFTER approval. Fields: id (unique slug), title, date (YYYY-MM-DD, Mountain Time), time (optional, free text e.g. '6:30 PM'), endDate (optional YYYY-MM-DD for multi-day items; hides after this day instead of date), place, details (one short line), flyer (optional, path relative to events/, e.g. 'flyers/2026-11-20-slug.jpg', max 1200px wide), link (optional URL), linkLabel (optional, default 'More info'). The events page hides an item once its endDate (or date, when endDate is empty) is before today in America/Denver. tools/prune_events.py deletes that item the same morning and removes flyer files that no HTML or JSON file still names. SAMPLE entries below are preview-only: remove before going live.
